summary: I developed an interactive educational game that allows children to experience what it is like to manage a lunar outpost. Players take charge of a Moon base make daily mission decisions, manage essential resources such as oxygen water food and power and respond to challenges like solar weather events and equipment problems. They can also explore lunar locations, complete science quizzes and upgrade their base. the project addresses the challenge by turning complex space exploration concepts into a fun hands-on learning experience. Instead of simply reading about life on the Moon players learn by making decisions and seeing how those decisions affect their crew and mission.
details: Moonbase is a fun interactive game where players get to experience what it might be like to manage a real Moon base. You take on the role of a mission commander responsible for keeping four astronauts safe for seven days. You have to manage important resources like oxygen water food power spare parts and radiation shielding. Each day you make decisions such as growing food reinforcing the shelter repairing life-support systems or saving energy. But every choice has consequences, so you have to think carefully! I created this project using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and published it online using Netlify. I wanted to make learning about space exploration more interesting than just reading facts from a textbook. The game introduces challenges astronauts could face on the Moon, including solar weather, limited supplies, and communication delays with Earth. My goal is to encourage younger students to enjoy science, think creatively solve problems and become curious about future space missions.
